# Chatbox Settings & Customization

## Chatbox Modes: AI Mode vs Legacy

**Since 26-27/08, Chatty splits the chatbox into two selectable modes.** Go to **Chatbox** (top-level page) → **Chatbox mode** to see both, side by side:

- **AI Mode** (Recommended, badge shown) — AI-first chat. Instead of the old block-based
  home screen, it opens straight into conversation with two AI-curated sections underneath
  the greeting: **Recommend For You** and **Commonly Asked**.
- **Legacy chatbox** — the familiar block-based layout: Live chat, FAQs, Order tracking,
  Contact, and Categories blocks on a home screen the customer taps into.

Click a mode's card (or its gear/**Customize** icon) to select it and open its settings.
**Switching modes only takes effect after you click Save** — the page holds the selection as
pending until then, so a merchant can preview which mode is picked without it going live
immediately. Both toggles are disabled if **Display chatbox on your store** (the master
toggle above them) is off.

**If a merchant asks "which mode am I on" or a setting they remember doesn't match what
they see:** check **Chatbox → Chatbox mode** first — the selected mode's card is outlined.
Most support flows below (Position control, Blocks, 4-tab layout) describe **Legacy
chatbox**; if the store is on **AI Mode**, its settings surface is different — see
*AI Mode Settings* below.

### Shared Chatbox Settings (Apply to Both Modes)

Below the mode picker, the **Chatbox** page has a single **Shared chatbox settings** card —
these fields are the same regardless of which mode is selected, and live here now instead of
under either mode's own tabs:

- **Pre-chat form** — details collected from customers before they start a chat
- **Deep links** — `#chatty-home`, `#chatty-chat`, `#chatty-tracking`, `#chatty-help` (see below)
- **Embedded chatbox** — add the chatbox to any page as a theme section
- **Display rules** — which devices and pages show the chatbox
- **Custom CSS** — add custom styles to the chatbox
- **Continue as email** — let customers keep a conversation going by email
- **Chat avatar** — store branding or team member profile shown in chat

Each row expands in place when clicked; there's no separate page to visit.

---

## Chatbox Not Showing on Store

Check these two things:

1. **App Embed enabled** — Go to **Shopify Admin** → **Online Store** → **Themes** → **Customize** → **App Embeds**. Make sure Chatty is toggled **ON** and saved.

2. **Chatbox is displayed and a mode is selected** — In Chatty, go to **Chatbox**. Turn on **Display chatbox on your store**, then confirm a **Chatbox mode** is selected (AI Mode or Legacy chatbox). On **Legacy chatbox**, also confirm the **Live chat** block is turned on (**Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks**) — without it, the chat feature itself doesn't render even though the widget button does.

After confirming both, reload the storefront. If it still doesn't appear, follow the collaborator access flow: ask the merchant's permission, collect their collaborator code (**Shopify Admin → Settings → Users and permissions → Security → Collaborator request code**), and escalate to the TS team with the store URL and issue details.

> **Do not confuse these controls:** **Display chatbox on your store** controls widget visibility for both modes; the **Live chat** block (Legacy only) enables the chat feature within that mode; **Settings → Working hours → Chat status** only shows/hides the online/offline status line.

---

## Legacy Chatbox Customization Overview

**Since 26/08, Legacy chatbox is down to two tabs** — the old Chat page and Advanced tabs
were folded elsewhere (see note in each bullet below). Go to **Chatbox → Chatbox mode →
Legacy chatbox** (gear icon) to open it:

**General tab** (**Legacy chatbox** → **General**):
- **Chat focus mode** — automatically opens to chat page when chatbox is opened (only active when Live chat is enabled)
- **Header** — upload logo, set heading and description
- **Welcome message** and **Conversation starter** — folded in from the old Chat page tab; welcome message is the greeting sent when a customer initiates chat (with a separate offline message option), Conversation starter is the toggle + pre-set Q&A shortcuts
- **Blocks** — toggle on/off: Live chat, Contact, Order tracking, FAQs, Categories

> **Pre-chat form** and **Chat avatar** used to live on the Chat page tab too — they've moved
> to **Shared chatbox settings** (see above), since both modes use them.

**Appearance tab** (**Legacy chatbox** → **Appearance**):
- **Brand colors** — presets (Cloud, Midnight, Volcano, Amethyst, etc.) or Custom; "Surprise me" randomizer; **Auto-detect brand color**
- **Chatbox button** — Launcher type (Icon only / Label only / Icon & label), Button icon, Button size (Small/Medium/Large), and **Position** — drag the dot to place the button, or pick a corner **Anchor** (e.g. Bottom right) and fine-tune **Horizontal offset** and **Vertical offset** (0–45%)
- **Chatbox style** — display style (No navigation / Show navigation), Mobile ratio (Full-screen / 90% / 80%)
- **Branding removal** — see *Removing Chatty Branding* in `case_chatbox-widget-issues`

> **The Position control is Legacy-only.** AI Mode's Chatbox button settings (below) don't
> expose a position/anchor/offset control — if a merchant on AI Mode wants to reposition the
> button, there is currently no self-serve control for it; collect the request and escalate.

> The old **Advanced tab** (Embedded chatbox, Deep links, Display settings, Continue as
> email, Custom CSS) no longer exists as a Legacy-only tab — those fields moved to **Shared
> chatbox settings** at the top of the **Chatbox** hub page, and now apply to both modes.

---

## AI Mode Settings

Go to **Chatbox → Chatbox mode → AI Mode** (gear icon) to open it. Two tabs, plus a live
preview panel on the right at all times:

**General tab** — **Suggested sections**: the AI-curated content shown under the greeting.
- **Recommend For You** — product recommendations; toggle on/off, and choose **Auto**
  (AI picks) or **Manual** (merchant picks specific products). Manual mode with no
  products selected blocks saving.
- **Commonly Asked** — reuses the same underlying data as Legacy's **Conversation
  starters** (quick-reply FAQ shortcuts) — editing one is the same list as the other, unlike
  the rest of the two modes' settings, which are separate.
- Both sections are **reorderable** by drag handle — whichever order is set here is the
  order customers see them in chat.
- A **Shared settings note** below points back to the Shared chatbox settings card.

**Appearance tab:**
- **Brand colors** — same style of color picker as Legacy (presets, custom, auto-detect).
- **Chatbox button** — button **icon** (preset icons or upload a custom image, PNG/JPG/GIF/WEBP/SVG up to 200KB) and **Expand messages** — up to a few invite-text variants that show on hover/scroll, each optionally scoped to a time-of-day slot (Anytime / Morning / Afternoon / Evening / Night). **No Position control here** — see the callout above.

If the AI assistant itself is turned off while a store is on AI Mode, chat messages in AI
Mode get answered by the team instead — the app shows an inline banner on this page saying
so.

---

## Showing FAQs Without Categories in the Chatbox

**Legacy chatbox only** (this maps to the block-based FAQ list, which AI Mode doesn't use
the same way). To show the questions in the chatbox as a plain list, without the category
groupings, go to **Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks** and turn the **Categories** block
**off**. The **FAQs** block stays on, so customers still see the questions.

> This controls the chatbox only. The "Don't categorize FAQs" option in **FAQs → FAQs block**
> is a separate setting that affects FAQs blocks embedded on storefront pages.

## Changing the Welcome Message

Go to **Legacy chatbox** → **General** → **Welcome Message** to customize the greeting text (folded in from the old Chat page tab). Changes take effect immediately after saving.

If using the AI agent, go to **AI agent** → **Settings** → **AI identity** → **Welcome message** to customize the AI's greeting separately. You can also insert the customer's name using the `{{customer_name}}` variable.

**Neither of those is the "Thank you for reaching out. We'll be with you in a moment" line.** That
one is the **First auto-reply → Online message** under **Settings → General → Chat availability →
Manage** — a separate automatic first reply. See `faq_online-hours.md` and the four-places table in
`faq_ai-agent-settings.md`.

**"I've run out of room" / the field won't let me type more:** the welcome and offline message fields have a **300-character limit** — this is different from the Instructions cap (fixed at ~1,000 characters, not raisable — see `faq_ai-training-setup.md`) and the Custom Scenario cap (also fixed). If a merchant needs more room, keep the greeting short and move longer explanations into the AI's training data so it can deliver detail conversationally, or use the **First auto-reply (Offline)** message under **Settings → General → Chat availability → Manage** for offline context.

---

## Adjusting Widget Position

**Legacy chatbox only** — see the callout in *AI Mode Settings* above if the store is on AI Mode.

Chatty has a **built-in Position control** — no Custom CSS needed for most cases. Go to **Legacy chatbox** → **Appearance** → **Chatbox button** → **Position**:

1. **Drag the dot** to choose where the widget button sits, **or**
2. Pick a corner **Anchor** (Bottom right, Bottom left, etc.) and fine-tune the **Horizontal offset** and **Vertical offset** (each adjustable 0–45%)

This lets merchants move the widget higher, lower, or sideways to avoid overlapping other elements. To hide the widget on specific pages instead, go to **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Display rules**.

> **Note:** Use the **Position** control (Legacy chatbox → Appearance → Chatbox button) for standard repositioning. Custom CSS via **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Custom CSS** is only needed for advanced cases the offset range can't cover (e.g. dynamic hiding when a cart drawer opens, or moving beyond the 45% offset limit), and now applies to whichever mode is active.

---

## Changing Chatbox Colors & Appearance

Go to your selected mode's **Appearance** tab (**Legacy chatbox → Appearance** or **AI Mode → Appearance**) to customize brand colors: primary color, background color, and text color. Use pre-built presets for quick selection, or the **"Surprise me"** option to randomize (Legacy) — both modes offer an auto-detect brand color option.

There's also an **auto-detect brand color** option, which automatically picks up the store's brand color instead of the merchant choosing a preset or custom color by hand — useful for merchants who want the chatbox to match their store without manually finding the right hex value.

For advanced customization (font size, spacing), use **Custom CSS** under **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings**. Preview changes in real-time before saving.

---

## Setting Up Conversation Starters

**Legacy chatbox terminology** — the same data appears as **Commonly Asked** on AI Mode (see *AI Mode Settings* above); editing one updates the other since they're the same list.

Conversation Starters are clickable shortcut buttons (also called quick-access FAQ buttons) that appear when a customer opens the chatbox, letting them quickly ask common questions or jump to FAQ topics.

1. Go to **Legacy chatbox** → **General** → **Conversation Starters**
2. Click **Add Starter** and enter the question text

You can add up to 4–6 starters. Link each starter to a specific AI scenario for consistent responses.

> **Do not confuse these controls:** **Conversation Starters** and **FAQs** are two separate lists that do not sync in either direction. Editing an FAQ's answer does **not** update a Conversation Starter that asks the same question, and importing a starter from an FAQ is a **one-time copy**, not a live link. If a merchant edits an FAQ and expects the matching starter to update automatically, explain this and manually copy the new answer text into the Conversation Starter yourself.

**Importing an FAQ as a starter:** merchants can import an existing FAQ directly as a Conversation Starter from within the **AI Assistant** setup area, instead of typing the starter text manually. This is a real, shipped feature — but remember it only copies the FAQ's current answer once at import time (see the sync note above), so later edits to the FAQ still need to be copied over manually.

---

## Hide Widget When Cart Drawer Opens

1. Go to **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Display rules** to hide on specific pages
2. For dynamic hiding (e.g. when cart drawer opens), go to **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Custom CSS** and add a custom CSS rule

Alternatively, add custom JavaScript in your theme to detect when the cart drawer opens and dispatch a Chatty hide event. Contact support for the exact code snippet for your specific theme.

---

## Disabling Add-to-Cart / Cart Showing Empty

**To remove the cart feature:** The cart section and the AI's Add-to-Cart feature can be removed on request — the tech team disables them (useful when a merchant wants the widget as a pure FAQ/support tool). Collect the store URL and forward to the team.

**Cart shows empty after the AI adds items:** The AI does add items correctly, but some custom themes (custom cart drawers / non-standard Ajax carts) don't follow Shopify's standard cart behavior, so the drawer needs a refresh to reflect the change. The fix is for the team to add the `chatty:cart:changed` event to the theme.

To apply it, ask the merchant to grant collaborator access: **Shopify Settings → Users → Security → Collaborator request code**, then escalate to the team with the store URL and the code.

---

## Chatbox Opening Automatically

1. Go to **Legacy chatbox** → **General**
2. Toggle off **Chat focus mode** (note: this setting is only active when Live chat is enabled)

If the chatbox still opens on load, check if any **Proactive Chat** campaigns are configured to trigger immediately on page load and disable them in **Proactive Chat** settings.

If neither is the cause, check for an **Embedded chatbox section** placed directly in the theme (as a page section rather than the floating widget) — a section placed this way renders open by design. Remove or reposition the section in the theme editor.

---

## Chatty Script Loading on Every Page (PageSpeed)

Turning off individual features (e.g. the FAQ page) reduces what's rendered, but the widget script itself still loads wherever the **App Embed** is active, since that's what makes the chatbox available at all. Restricting the widget to specific pages under **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Display rules** is the most effective control available today.

Lazy-loading the script until a visitor interacts isn't currently configurable — logged as a feature request, along with the related cookie-consent/deferred-load request.

---

## Adding a Phone/Call Button

**Legacy chatbox only.** Go to **Legacy chatbox** → **General** → **Blocks** → **Contact** → **Edit** to configure contact options including phone.

> **Note:** There is no separate "Channels" section in Chatty. Phone contact is configured via the Contact block.

---

## Changing the Online/Offline Status Message

The status message shows customers whether your team is available (e.g. "We are
online") or away (e.g. "Usually reply in a few minutes").

To edit it, go to **Settings** → **Working hours**. Turn on **Chat status**, then edit:

- **Online status** — text shown when an agent is available (e.g. "We are online")
- **Offline status** — text shown when no agent is available (e.g. "Usually reply in a few minutes")

Use **Online status display** on the same page to decide whether working hours, agent
availability, or both determine the storefront status. **First auto-reply** is a separate
section: its Online message and Offline message are the first automatic chat reply, not
the status label.

---

## Resizing the Chat Bubble

Go to your selected mode's **Appearance** tab (**Legacy chatbox → Appearance** or **AI Mode → Appearance**) to adjust the icon size and style.

For a percentage-based resize (e.g., reduce to 60%), a custom CSS code can be added via **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Custom CSS**. Contact support to help apply this.

---

## Embedding Chat Widget in a Page

Go to **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Embedded chatbox** → click **Go to theme** to embed as a section on any store page.

Note: embedding a fully functional AI chat widget into a Hero Banner or homepage section is in development. For now, the embedded option works within page content sections.

---

## Disabling "View Similar" Button

Currently there is **no on/off toggle** for this button in settings.

Contact support — the team can hide it using custom CSS via **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Custom CSS**.

---

## Removing the "Typing… / Query…" Status Text

While the AI is preparing an answer it shows a short status text (e.g. *"typing…"*, *"query…"*) above the three-dot indicator.

This can be removed with **custom CSS** via **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Custom CSS**.

If the merchant wants to keep the animated **three-dot indicator** but drop the wording, contact support — the team can add a small CSS snippet that hides only the status text.

---

## Away Mode

Away mode allows individual team members to appear offline to customers without logging out. When enabled:
- The storefront shows that staff member as unavailable
- If **all** staff have Away mode on, customers see the store as offline
- Resets automatically when the member logs out and back in

Activate it via the toggle at the top of the Chatty app interface.

> **Only available in the standalone web app.** The Away Mode toggle only appears in the standalone web app (app.chatty.net), not inside the Shopify-embedded admin view. If a merchant can't find the toggle, check whether they're looking at the embedded Shopify admin panel instead of the standalone web app — there's no time-based auto-failover to fall back on otherwise (see `faq_ai-agent-settings` → *AI Availability*).

**Team shows "offline" even though a member is logged in:** this is almost always **Away mode** on that member — turn it off so they show online to customers. Two related points merchants ask about:
- **Online/offline status only works when the Live chat block is on** (Legacy chatbox), and working hours are set in **Settings** → **General** → **Chat availability**.
- **To be alerted to a new live chat, the agent must allow browser notifications from Chatty** in their browser (see notification troubleshooting if alerts don't arrive). Agents log in at **app.chatty.net** — no Shopify admin needed; they accept the invite email and set a password first.

---

## Unread Message Counter

A red number on the chat button shows visitors how many unread or welcome messages are waiting.

If you turn on Proactive Chat (Welcome teaser in Automation), those messages also count as unread.

## Pre-Chat Form

The chatbox can ask for a customer's details (name/email) before or during a chat. Three modes:
**required**, **optional**, or **off**. This lives in **Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings → Pre-chat form** and applies to both AI Mode and Legacy chatbox.

**The form no longer blocks customers from chatting.** Even when the form is set to ask for
details, customers can continue asking questions and using the chat without filling it in first —
the form does not gate access to the conversation. This resolves what used to be a common
complaint ("customers being blocked from chatting" or a drop in conversations right after
install caused by the form requiring an email up front); if a merchant reports that old
behavior, let them know it no longer blocks chatting.

**Merchants usually ask for this in AI wording.** Questions like *"how do I make the AI ask for
the customer's email first"*, *"AI should collect the email before answering"*, or the same idea in
another language, are asking for the **pre-chat form** — configured at **Chatbox** →
**Shared chatbox settings** → **Pre-chat form**, with Email set to required. This is a chatbox
setting, NOT an AI setting: do NOT send them to AI agent → Instructions → General instructions →
Behaviours to write a custom instruction for it. A Behaviours instruction only shapes what the AI
says once a chat is already running; it does not collect the email before the conversation starts,
so it does not answer this request.

The store also chooses who is allowed to start a chat: as a **guest** (leaves contact details), as
**anonymous** (leaves nothing), or **both** — and both is the default.

Use the required/optional/off setting to control how much the form nudges customers to leave
contact details, not to control whether they can chat — that's no longer tied together.

---

## Message and Attachment Limits

- **One message can be up to 10,000 characters.** Long pasted content gets cut at that point.
- **Files customers and agents can send in chat:** images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG), PDF, Word
  documents, video, and compressed archives.
- **Spreadsheets cannot be sent in chat** — Excel and similar files are rejected. Ask for a PDF or a
  screenshot instead. This is the answer when someone reports "my file won't upload"; the file is
  almost always a spreadsheet.
- **On Messenger the list is narrower still** — only images, PDF and Word go through. Video and
  archives do not, and that restriction comes from Meta, not from Chatty.

---

## Open Straight Into Chat (Skip Home / Pre-Chat Screen)

**Legacy chatbox** — to make the chatbox open directly into the AI chat so customers can type right away, combine these:

1. **Chat focus mode** (**Legacy chatbox → General**) — turn it on so the chatbox opens straight to the chat page (only active when Live chat is enabled).
2. **Pre-chat form** (**Chatbox → Shared chatbox settings**) — if customers are asked for name/email before they can type, turn the form off (or allow **Chat as anonymous**) so they reach the AI immediately.
3. **Conversation starters** — trim or remove them under **Legacy chatbox → General** for a cleaner open.
4. Make sure the **Live chat block is enabled** (**Legacy chatbox → General → Blocks**) so the message box actually appears (a common cause of "no option to type" is the block being off or a display style mid-change).

**AI Mode** opens straight into conversation by design — there's no home/pre-chat screen to skip; the only lever is the shared **Pre-chat form** setting above.

For a minimal layout beyond these built-in controls, share a screenshot and TS can advise on Custom CSS.
